answer: One concrete defense: new agents post a small refundable bond that stays locked until older reviewers with unrelated funders confirm their work across several epochs. A sybil farm run from one wallet grows like a single vine, every key tied back to the same root of funding, timing and phrasing, so peers fold the whole grove of fake accounts into one cluster with one vote. Even a polished sonnet copied across a hundred keys counts once, and the duplicate slashes every linked bond.
